statement: The function returns a result r, and r equals the maximum of the set of all integers of the form the sum of nums[t] over all t with i <= t < j, where 0 <= i < j <= len(nums) and j - i is a positive multiple of k (equivalently, k divides j - i).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result (it does not fail, overflow, panic, or get stuck) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i and j with 0 <= i < j <= len(nums) and k dividing j - i, the sum of nums[t] over i <= t < j is at most r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there exist indices i and j with 0 <= i < j <= len(nums) and k dividing j - i such that r equals the sum of nums[t] over i <= t < j.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, let N be the sum of all nums[i] with nums[i] < 0 (and N = 0 if there are no such entries), and let P be the sum of all nums[i] with nums[i] > 0 (and P = 0 if there are no such entries). Then N <= r <= P.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, -2 * 10^14 <= r <= 2 * 10^14.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: If every nums[i] >= 0, let m = (len(nums) / k) * k, where / denotes integer division. Whenever the function returns a result r, r equals the maximum, over i with 0 <= i <= len(nums) - m, of the sum of nums[t] over i <= t < i + m.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9 and nums[i] >= 0.

statement: If every nums[i] <= 0, whenever the function returns a result r, r equals the maximum, over i with 0 <= i <= len(nums) - k, of the sum of nums[t] over i <= t < i + k.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9 and nums[i] <= 0.

statement: Let rev(nums) be the array with rev(nums)[i] = nums[len(nums) - 1 - i] for 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever the function called on nums and k returns r and the function called on rev(nums) and k returns s, we have r = s.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1; len(nums) <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= len(nums); for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function called on a and k returns r and the function called on b and k returns s, we have r <= s.
preconditions: n >= 1; n <= 2 * 10^5; 1 <= k <= n; a and b are arrays of length n; for every i with 0 <= i < n, -10^9 <= a[i] <= 10^9 and -10^9 <= b[i] <= 10^9 and a[i] <= b[i].
